name: Taiwan Semiconductor
thesis: Leading-edge logic foundry monopoly (3nm/2nm) with an unassailable pricing moat and structural AI accelerator / HPC capex tailwind. Revenue and operating margins are expanding (Q1'26 revenue NT$1,134.1B, +35.1% YoY; gross margin 66.2%; operating margin 58.0%). Evaluated as a premier capital-preservation / earnings-growth alternative to cyclical Korean index exposure (Samsung/SK Hynix memory plays): TSMC delivers fortress cash generation (NT$3.38T cash vs NT$1.02T debt = ~$74B net cash), node-lock customer stickiness (Apple, Nvidia, AMD, Broadcom), and advanced packaging (CoWoS) pricing power without memory commodity price collapse risk. Geopolitical risk in Taiwan Strait remains the primary macro overhang, buffered by overseas fab diversification (Kumamoto, Arizona, Dresden). DCF fair value is $366.47 base (bull $480.40 / bear $276.47) vs current market price ~$414-$472 (+13% to +29% premium). MoS bar 20%.
key_driver: 3nm + 5nm wafer volumes × ASP × utilization; CoWoS capacity expansion and HPC node monopoly

break_rules.narrative: Revenue declining YoY for 2 consecutive quarters — outright top-line contraction.
GAAP operating margin negative for 2 consecutive quarters — operating loss.
Gross margin below 20% for 2 consecutive quarters — severe pricing/cost issue.
GAAP net income negative for 2 consecutive quarters — bottom-line loss.
Capex/Revenue above 25% for 2 consecutive Qs — capex bloat without proportional revenue.
FCF margin below 5% for 2 consecutive Qs — cash conversion broken.
Operating cash flow declining >10% YoY for 2 consecutive Qs.
